title: Guild Hall stars
description: data/hallStars.json: the Guild Hall's authored sky. The workspace holds the same two maps as hallConstellations and hallStars. The shape is documented and read in src/config/hallStars.js (loaded by src/config/registries/hallStarRegistry.js; a held rank's rules apply guild-wide through src/systems/progression/hallModifiers.js); authored on the CMS's Guild Hall page (cms/src/components/hallStars/, cms/src/engine/hallSky.js). Keys not listed here are reported as warnings.

point.description: In the sky's unit space, centred on the Hall (0, 0); +x right, +y down.

skill.description: The skill it belongs to, if any.

tag.description: TAG_SIDES (src/config/hallStars.js): where its name tag sits.

links.description: hall, or other star ids (built-in ones included); it opens once a linked star has a rank.

outline.description: The item (or sprite) whose outline the sky draws over it; left out, the sky picks by kind.

opensRing.description: A ring star: buying its first rank lets the guild settle that ring (a whole number from 2; src/systems/world/ringStars.js).

ranks.description: Rank r is the r-th entry's whole effect, not an increment.

tier.description: The tier the owner gives the rank (the ledger prices by it).

rules.description: Held guild-wide while the rank is held.

lines.description: Passive Production lines the Guild Hall pays every lap.
